purpose: Pre-staged reroll/refinement values for the Charming Glance Warlord's Rest unlock. This file does not change the live site by itself.

release_gate.gear_level_note: Global-English Prydwen transfer evidence shows the Warlord-era Ink Blade at gear level 162. Older CN material describes the analogous second S2 dungeon as level 165, so Global values are keyed to the observed English-client Lv162 gear.

display_policy.question_mark_means: Approximate, inferred, observed-but-not-proven-max, or not directly confirmed from the current English-client Affix Preview.
display_policy.special_affix_rule: Special dual-stat affixes jump to 3x their pre-160 values once the receiving gear is over the 160 breakpoint.
display_policy.normal_affix_rule: Normal percentage affixes grow gradually after the 160 breakpoint; older-server Warlord evidence reports about +50% at this first post-160 gear step.
display_policy.flat_affix_rule: Flat-number affixes scale with receiving gear level and should not be given a fake season-wide fixed cap without an Affix Preview capture.

Crit Rate.basis: Pre-160 ~5.00% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling; independently consistent with Global community reports of ~7.5% high-end single Crit rolls.

Crit DMG.basis: Pre-160 ~7.50% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling.

Block Rate.basis: Pre-160 ~5.00% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling.

Crit RES.basis: Pre-160 ~5.00% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling.

Accuracy.basis: Pre-160 ~5.00% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling.

Healing Boost.basis: Pre-160 ~10.00% max x ~1.5 first post-160 normal-affix scaling.

Crit Rate + Crit DMG.basis: Direct older-server post-160 tier data plus Global S2 community corroboration of 15% Crit + 23% Crit DMG gear.

Crit Rate + Accuracy.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table; Global community also reports ~15% Accuracy paired with Crit, but no direct current English Affix Preview capture retained.

Crit RES + Block Rate.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table.

Block Rate + Block Efficiency.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table.

DMG RES + Healing Boost.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table.

PvP Bonus DMG + PvP DMG RES.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table.

PvE Bonus DMG + PvE DMG RES.basis: Exact 3x special-affix rule and older-server affix table.

HP.basis: Same receiving-gear-level scaling rule; exact Warlord Affix Preview maximum not found.

SPD.basis: Same receiving-gear-level scaling rule; exact Warlord Affix Preview maximum not found.

Elemental Mastery.basis: Prydwen confirms flat affixes scale with receiving gear level and shows Elemental Mastery as a refinable line; exact Warlord Affix Preview maximum not found.

Effect Hit Rate.basis: Prydwen shows Effect Hit as a refinable flat-number line; exact Warlord Affix Preview maximum not found.

DMG RES (standalone).basis: Current English gamefile table exposes the DMG RES + Healing Boost paired affix; a standalone refinement maximum was not established.

later_s2_reference_not_for_warlord_displ.note: These are older-server full-season ranges and must not be mislabeled as fresh Warlord/Lv162 maxima. Normal affixes continue growing after the first post-160 dungeon.
